topic: Bar stools, hay bales, kids' chairs and bleachers
summary: Bar-height stools seat at 30 in (0.76 m); one molded stool is 17 x 17 x 30 in (0.43 x 0.43 x 0.76 m), a metal one has a 12 in seat and a footrest. Hay bales for seating: a real small bale is about 13 x 14 x 19 in, while a rental faux bale sturdy enough to sit on is 20 x 36 in and 17 in tall (0.51 x 0.91 x 0.43 m). Children's chairs for ages 2 to 5 have a 13.5 in seat and are 23 in (0.58 m) tall overall. Portable 3-row bleachers have a 30 in high, 60 in deep (0.76 x 1.52 m) footprint; 7.5 ft sections hold 15 people and 15 ft sections 36 (by the maker); rise is 8 in per row with a 24 in tread. Another mobile unit is 3 tiers, 79 x 62 in, seats 15. Planners must check local codes: guardrails are often required on rows above 30 in, and need level ground.
